description: This Java class named LoggingExpiredStrategy handles the LoggingExpired command within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically as a strategy to disable logging upon receiving such a command.

classes.name: LoggingExpiredStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy to handle LoggingExpired commands by returning a DISABLE_LOGGING action.

methods.name: LoggingExpiredStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with the LoggingExpired class type.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action DISABLE_LOGGING when the LoggingExpired command is handled.
